scope: Bounded public search for independent SH-201 raw-cutoff frequency anchors. No DSP edits, outreach, accounts, purchases or other-product DSP assumptions.
queries: "SH-201" フィルター 周波数 測定 -site:roland.com -site:manualslib.com

new_findings.author: misutrax
new_findings.observed: Owner reports designing a SuperSaw sound using modest resonance and LP24, aiming around1–4kHz for brighter harmonics. No raw cutoff value, measurement method, full patch or calibrated frequency plot appears.
new_findings.deduction: Subjective target range cannot supply a raw-cutoff anchor.
new_findings.confidence: High for article content, no numerical calibration confidence

new_findings.observed: Linked primary video metadata: Roland SH-201 SUPERSAW 2x, uploader Synthwave-jp8k,23seconds, description#shorts, no subtitles or automatic captions. No media downloaded in this pass.
new_findings.deduction: Metadata does not recover raw patch/calibration; video content was not analyzed.

new_findings.observed: Author-published SH-201 controller specification: Upper Filter Cutoff CC74, Lower CC102, Audio Filter CC2; all valueRange0..127. The JSON contains no raw-to-Hz conversion, physical cutoff table or measured examples.
new_findings.deduction: Primary evidence for app routing, third-party documentation of hardware controls, not Roland DSP calibration.

retrieval_limits: Web reader returned429 for the MIDI Mod parameter list; one ordinary public curl retrieval succeeded.
Web YouTube fetch throttled; public yt-dlp metadata retrieval succeeded without accounts or media acquisition.
Unrelated KEMET/TOKIN SH-201 line filters, Motorola shields, price listings and other Roland devices were rejected.
result: No independent raw-cutoff physical-frequency anchor recovered after16 multilingual queries and bounded follow-up of the two new primary leads. This is a bounded feasibility failure, not proof no public anchor exists. Existing conditional audio fits must retain their labels.
